artifacts/forever-simulator/optimization.name: Beast Mastery · first-pass tested

prepull: Use Aspect of the Hawk 10 seconds before the pull.

prepullBindings.text: Use Aspect of the Hawk 10 seconds before the pull.

rotationGuidance.petInstruction: The measured setup uses a Raptor at full uptime and 1.2-second attack speed, with its implemented offensive abilities on autocast.
rotationGuidance.scenario: Level 60, one level-63 Dragonkin, 300 seconds, stationary ranged attacks at 12 yards with the measured gear, buffs and consumes.
rotationGuidance.instruction: Use Aspect of the Hawk 10 seconds before the pull. The measured setup uses a Raptor at full uptime and 1.2-second attack speed, with its implemented offensive abilities on autocast. Keep Auto Shot enabled. Check priorities from the top: use the first available action whose conditions hold, then start again at the top.
priorities: Use enabled cooldowns, including the modeled Rapid Fire, Bestial Wrath and Intimidation handling when available.
Use Intimidation when available if your mana is more than 80%.
Use Summon Hawk when available if (the number of active summoned Hawks is less than 2 or the earliest-expiring Hawk has at most the travel time of Summon Hawk remaining).
Use Serpent Sting when available if Serpent Sting is not active on the target.
Use Arcane Shot when available if your mana is at least 15%.
